formalization.project_name: Oxtoby's Banach–Mazur characterization of Baire spaces

mathematical_sources.note: The classical Banach–Mazur Baire characterization is recalled on printed p.2; the full finite opponent-history strategy convention and payoffs are specified in Section2, printed pp.2–3. The proof here develops the disjoint-response-level construction rather than claiming to reproduce Oxtoby’s unconsulted original. PDF SHA256 e289b7691238657b2d686f21b2cb2bf0900a569e7db0bdd41045e501523ef47f. No novelty, priority or first-formalization claim. The paper’s strong Choquet and infinite product theorems are outside scope.
mathematical_sources.title: More on products of Baire spaces, arXiv:1702.06197v3

mathematical_sources.note: The introduction, printed p.1, recalls Oxtoby’s characterization and specifies alternating nonempty open sets and common-point payoff. Corollary3.3, printed p.6, includes the classical equivalence for nonempty spaces. This package proves that classical game criterion and explicitly extends it to the empty space by absence of initial strategies; it does not claim the paper’s finite/countable-family variants or productiveness results. PDF SHA256 3f6739c64f46d09aa96385c57ddaa1c5607725ca137412b620b9597414dfa4a2. Original Oxtoby1957 and the cited Kechris Theorem8.11 were not consulted.
mathematical_sources.title: Some variations of the Banach-Mazur game, arXiv:2104.02269v2

related_formalizations.note: Canonical BaireSpace, all-open topology, Dense/closure, indexed pairwise disjointness, Zorn and open-subspace Baireness supply infrastructure. Eight material imported declarations retain exact pinned sources and independent compiled meanings. Exact Lean11acb17 core List/length sources and literal four-definition game model are audited separately. Comparator definition_names is empty; all four game definitions and the strategy structure remain fixed non-target dependencies of the seven selected theorem types. No imported Banach–Mazur/Choquet strategy characterization was located in the exact Mathlib revision.

The two maximal-disjoint/dense-refinement helper proofs are reused under Apache-2.0 with preserved attribution. The new full-history strategy tree, coherent-play extraction, counterstrategy, equivalence and boundary proofs are substantive new package code. Challenge imports only canonical Mathlib modules and does not import this earlier project.
